messages:
elaine-cs: Customer (AcmeHealth) opened a ticket: after our scheduled API key rotation at 03:00 UTC, ~10% of their requests from EU are getting 401 invalid_api_key. They say some services work while others fail. Logs show `signature_verification failed` and a short-lived 401 spike.
devon-support: ack. Can you paste the sample failing request (headers + first 200 bytes) and the client sdk version?
customer-rep: here — Node app using redwood-js-sdk@1.4.2. Header: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` for internal services, but public webhooks call with `X-API-Key: abcde...` (new key). Failing requests include both. Sample error attached: `{"error":"invalid_api_key","detail":"key not found"}`
maria-ops: interesting. We rotated the primary key and left the legacy alias for 12h with a replay window. Possible causes: env var shadowing, sidecar not reloading, or edge cache returning old auth result.
raj-sre: quick checks: 1) Are Vault leases rewrapped on deploy? 2) Did sidecars pick up new secret? 3) Any CDN edge caches with auth lookups?
elaine-cs: customer says they redeployed app services but didn't restart the sidecar process that reads from the mounted secret (helm post-upgrade doesn't kill sidecar). They restarted now and still see failures for some lambda consumers.
maria-ops: run this to confirm secret value in pod: `kubectl exec -it deploy/web-frontend -- cat /etc/secrets/API_KEY | xxd -p | head` — look for whitespace/newline or hidden chars. Also check mounted file mode; some runtimes trim trailing \n.
devon-support: also ask them to verify header name consistency — we had a case where load balancer rewrote `X-API-Key` to lowercase `x-api-key` and a proxy dropped it. Can you capture an nginx access log where status=401?
customer-rep: confirmed: two pods had api key file with trailing newline, others didn't. Lambda consumers call through an API Gateway that caches auth results for 5m. We flushed cache but still ~3% failing. Attached a failing header dump showing `x-api-key: abcde...` (lowercase).
raj-sre: lowercase shouldn't matter in HTTP headers, but our front proxy normalizes headers to canonical keys. If the proxy did a conditional routing to an auth service by region, it could be hitting an old auth cache. Check envoy cluster health too.
elaine-cs: vault-bot posted rewrap event at 03:00 UTC: `vault kv put secret/apps/acme/api_key value=redacted lease=24h rewrap=true`. But I see in audit logs a second write at 03:04 with a different KMS key alias — possible double-wrap causing token mismatch for services that read via KMS alias A vs alias B.
vault-bot: Vault audit: write secret secret/apps/acme/api_key id=64b9 event=write key_alias=projects/redwood/keys/alias-uk region=eu lease_ttl=24h
maria-ops: aha — some consumer runners in eu-west were configured to unwrap using alias `alias-eu-1` while the latest write used `alias-uk`. If unwrapping uses the alias metadata, older runners will fail signature verification. Short-term fix: rewrap secret to include both alias metadata or rotate alias back.
devon-support: proposed mitigation: 1) rewrap secret with both alias metadata tags (run `vault kv patch secret/apps/acme/api_key metadata.aliases=[alias-eu-1,alias-uk]`), 2) restart sidecars in a rolling fashion to pick up new file (kubectl rollout restart --namespace acme deploy), 3) flush API gateway cache and edge CDN (purge path /auth/verify).
raj-sre: also add a temporary fallback in router: if primary auth lookup fails, try legacy key alias lookup for the next 2 hours. I'll open a quick canary rule in prod to test.
customer-rep: performed rewrap with alias eu-1 and restarted sidecars — failing rate dropped to near 0. They purged CDN and API GW caches.
elaine-cs: follow-ups: recommend we update rotation runbook to 1) ensure alias metadata consistency across regions, 2) force sidecar restart or provide hot-reload signal, 3) ensure CDN/GW cache purge step is in rotation playbook. Also ask SDK team to make Node client tolerant of trailing newlines in mounted secrets.
devon-support: noted. I've filed ticket SPT-3921 for runbook updates and SPT-3922 for SDK trimming fix. Thanks all :tada:
